title: Stryd Form Power Change by Shoe
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stryd:run
| stats avg(form_power_w) as avg_form_power_w avg(power_per_kg) as avg_power_per_kg by shoe_name
| sort 0 - avg_form_power_w
value: Shoe splits help show whether a change in gear is affecting running economy rather than just pace.
implementation: Send form power events to `index=personal` and keep `shoe_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of form power by shoes.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which shoess stand out most for form power.
